research_state.previous_question: Can the production route make a real statistics-methodology paper talk from an unseen paper bundle?
research_state.prior_belief: Stage 4 passed on engineering evidence, but real paper generalization is unproven.
research_state.new_evidence: The source bundle is built from the 28-page JSS brms paper, with model equations, fitting workflow, kidney example figures, comparison tables, and stated limitations.
research_state.evidence_quality: Public JSS article under CC BY; source PDF and committed figure/table crops are hashed.
research_state.belief_update: The deck should be judged as a brms paper talk, not a synthetic calibration update.
research_state.successes: The paper provides native multilevel notation, Stan/HMC workflow, worked examples, posterior visualizations, package comparison tables, and explicit limitations.
research_state.failures: Default priors and syntactically valid Stan prior strings still require analyst judgement; missing-value imputation and modularized interfaces are not supported in the comparison table.
research_state.largest_uncertainty: Whether existing generic production layouts can make this real methods paper readable without tuning.
research_state.frozen_items: Use only the frozen source bundle and normal exact-CUHK production entrypoint.
research_state.stop_items: Do not modify production code, selector, layouts, gold, or generated TeX after inspecting output.
research_state.next_discriminating_experiment: Submit final rendered pages and contact sheet to task-local visual review.
research_state.decision_needed: Reviewer and Planner decide whether this one-shot deck reaches mature paper-talk quality.

quantitative_plots.supports: Kidney example marginal effects show age, sex, disease, and age-by-sex population-level predictors.
The package comparison table records broad brms model support and remaining feature limits.

model_diagrams.supports: brm transforms user model information into Stan code/data, then post-processes fitted results in brms.

equations.supports: brms parameterizes group-level covariance through standard deviations and an LKJ correlation prior.

experiment_logs.supports: The conclusion positions brms as a flexible Stan-backed interface while preserving Bayesian workflow responsibilities.

failed_experiments.supports: brms can pass priors to Stan, but meaningful prior choice remains analyst responsibility.
